At the outset, learned advocate for the applicants has pointed out that applicant no.3-Manjibhai Pamabhai Vaghera has expired and produced death certificate, which is taken on record.

In view of the same, the proceedings stands abated qua applicant no.3.
2.

Learned advocate Mr.Rajput identifies respondent no.2 and confirms correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her.

3. With the consent of learned advocate for the applicants NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11857/2020 ORDER DATED: 11/01/2024 undefined and learned advocate for respondents, present application is taken up for final disposal today.

5. Learned advocate for the applicants has taken this Court through the factual matrix arising out of the present application.
6. At the outset, it is submitted that the parties have amicably resolved the dispute.
